title: Python's Instance, Class, and Static Methods Demystified
description: Compare instance methods vs class methods vs static methods in Python, and learn when each one earns its place in your code.
summary: Instance, class, and static methods each serve a distinct role in Python, and knowing when to use one over another is key to writing clean, maintainable code. Instance methods operate on individual objects using self , while class methods use cls to access class-level data.
takeaways: If you want to know what all of this means in practice, and you like to learn by running code snippets and reasoning about them, then keep on reading.
